svg.title: Syntopic Workflow Graph Editor v1.0
svg.desc: Premium desktop workflow graph editor for Syntopic with infinite canvas, draggable nodes, execution visualization, minimap, node inspector, debug timeline, and orchestration controls.

g.text: Build, inspect, orchestrate, and debug AI workflows on an infinite canvas.
Search nodes, tools, memories, agents, runs
Drag onto the canvas or press ⌘K
Breakpoints • live trace • step through execution
Infinite graph • modular execution • native memory
Drag nodes, connect ports, zoom, pan, and debug live execution.
Scroll to zoom • drag to pan
Selected LLM node • live execution enabled
Explain routing, suggest fixes, or generate a new branch.
Last step: asked retrieval for workspace memory
Step through nodes, watch tokens, inspect I/O, and pause at breakpoints.
24 nodes • 7 active paths • 1 paused branch • 2 approvals
